channel.title: Ocrolus incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Ocrolus's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Delays in Document Processing Services [resolved]
item.description: The backlog has returned to normal levels, and turnaround time (TAT) has been steadily improving. We continue to actively monitor TAT and overall system health.

item.title: Import to Encompass Modal Not Loading [resolved]
item.description:
The issue impacting the Import to Encompass modal has been resolved. Based on the update from ICE, Encompass Partner Connect is now fully operational.
All backlog orders are currently being processed, and new orders are processing immediately.
Note: Orders submitted through Encompass Partner Connect prior to 7:30 AM ET may need to be resubmitted.
